example.english: This singer's new album is very popular.

example.pinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī shēn qǐng le xīn zhuān lì
example.english: The company has filed for a new patent.

example.hanzi: 太阳能可以转化成电能。
example.pinyin: tài yáng néng kě yǐ zhuǎn huà chéng diàn néng
example.english: Solar energy can be converted into electricity.

example.hanzi: 他很快就转换了话题。
example.pinyin: tā hěn kuài jiù zhuǎn huàn le huà tí
example.english: He quickly switched the subject.

example.hanzi: 他把这家小店转让给了朋友。
example.pinyin: tā bǎ zhè jiā xiǎo diàn zhuǎn ràng gěi le péng you
example.english: He signed the little shop over to a friend.

example.hanzi: 公司决定把业务转向国外市场。
example.pinyin: gōng sī jué dìng bǎ yè wù zhuǎn xiàng guó wài shì chǎng
example.english: The company decided to shift its business toward overseas markets.

example.hanzi: 他们用鲜花装饰了整个会场。
example.pinyin: tā men yòng xiān huā zhuāng shì le zhěng gè huì chǎng
example.english: They decorated the whole venue with fresh flowers.

example.hanzi: 那辆车撞在了路边的树上。
example.pinyin: nà liàng chē zhuàng zài le lù biān de shù shang
example.english: The car crashed into a tree by the road.

example.hanzi: 外国资本进入了这个市场。
example.pinyin: wài guó zī běn jìn rù le zhè ge shì chǎng
example.english: Foreign capital has moved into this market.

example.hanzi: 这家公司的资产比去年增加了。
example.pinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī de zī chǎn bǐ qù nián zēng jiā le
example.english: This company's assets have grown since last year.

example.hanzi: 这家公司资助了不少穷孩子上学。
example.pinyin: zhè jiā gōng sī zī zhù le bù shǎo qióng hái zi shàng xué
example.english: This company has funded schooling for a good many poor children.

example.hanzi: 警察在现场找到了子弹。
example.pinyin: jǐng chá zài xiàn chǎng zhǎo dào le zǐ dàn
example.english: Police found a bullet at the scene.

example.hanzi: 请你仔细看看这份合同。
example.pinyin: qǐng nǐ zǐ xì kàn kan zhè fèn hé tong
example.english: Please read this contract over carefully.

example.hanzi: 她今天穿了一件紫色的裙子。
example.pinyin: tā jīn tiān chuān le yí jiàn zǐ sè de qún zi
example.english: She is wearing a purple skirt today.

example.pinyin: fù mǔ wèi tā de chéng jì gǎn dào zì háo
example.english: His parents are proud of what he has achieved.

example.pinyin: jǐng fāng pái chú le zì shā de kě néng
example.english: The police have ruled out suicide.

example.hanzi: 这些工作都是他自愿做的。
example.pinyin: zhè xiē gōng zuò dōu shì tā zì yuàn zuò de
example.english: He took on all this work of his own accord.

example.hanzi: 公司总裁明天将回答记者的问题。
example.pinyin: gōng sī zǒng cái míng tiān jiāng huí dá jì zhě de wèn tí
example.english: The company chairman will take questions from reporters tomorrow.

example.hanzi: 参加考试的总数超过了三千人。
example.pinyin: cān jiā kǎo shì de zǒng shù chāo guò le sān qiān rén
example.english: The total number sitting the exam passed three thousand.

example.hanzi: 等了两个小时，车总算来了。
example.pinyin: děng le liǎng ge xiǎo shí chē zǒng suàn lái le
example.english: After a two-hour wait, the bus finally came.

example.hanzi: 总体来看，今年的情况不错。
example.pinyin: zǒng tǐ lái kàn jīn nián de qíng kuàng bú cuò
example.english: Overall, this year's picture is a good one.

example.hanzi: 交通问题阻碍了当地的发展。
example.pinyin: jiāo tōng wèn tí zǔ ài le dāng dì de fā zhǎn
example.english: Transport problems have held back the area's development.

example.hanzi: 公司组织了一次员工培训。
example.pinyin: gōng sī zǔ zhī le yí cì yuán gōng péi xùn
example.english: The company ran a training session for its staff.

example.hanzi: 他昨晚喝醉了，什么也不记得。
example.pinyin: tā zuó wǎn hē zuì le shén me yě bú jì de
example.english: He got drunk last night and remembers nothing.

example.hanzi: 他是一位很受学生尊敬的老教授。
example.pinyin: tā shì yí wèi hěn shòu xué shēng zūn jìng de lǎo jiào shòu
example.english: He is an old professor his students look up to.

example.hanzi: 我们应该尊重别人的选择。
example.pinyin: wǒ men yīng gāi zūn zhòng bié rén de xuǎn zé
example.english: We should respect other people's choices.

example.hanzi: 每个人都要遵守这里的规定。
example.pinyin: měi ge rén dōu yào zūn shǒu zhè lǐ de guī dìng
example.english: Everyone has to abide by the rules here.
